fina_indicator.revision_capability: terminal response may expose variants, but no revision-specific publication evidence; observation history begins at RawBatch retrieval

date_semantics.f_ann_date: vendor actual announcement date, not revision publication evidence
date_semantics.update_flag: vendor update marker, not an ordering timestamp
date_semantics.report_type: retain exact type; cumulative derivation supports consolidated type 1 only

fina_indicator.missing_semantics: null=vendor_null; omitted business key=not_provided; no source fallback
fina_indicator.terminal_history_risk: historical values fetched now are best_effort; safe/operational can use only from actual observation

fallback_policy: supplier_field_only.v1; no cross-endpoint fallback for indicator or valuation
membership_policy: index_weight snapshot intervals bounded by explicit next snapshot or scope end; bak_basic one represented civil day; no stock_basic industry fallback

valuation_denominators.pe: supplier total market value / net profit; loss may be null
valuation_denominators.pb: supplier total market value / (net assets - other equity instruments)
valuation_denominators.ps: supplier total market value / latest annual report revenue

report_type_policy: preserve source types; do not mix cumulative/standalone/parent-company; type 1 only for first stable-derived contract
request_semantics: fina_indicator start_date/end_date bound report end_date; announcement remains the availability date, never replaced by report period. Versioned correction based on explicit frozen range response.
